missed.why: A family P2 did not name: a 3-axis analogue MEMS accelerometer with single-ended XOUT, YOUT, ZOUT. It does NOT pass every value, so the re-rank should drop it on rule 4 and Digi-Key was not read. Data sheet ADXL356/ADXL357 Rev. A (6/2020), https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/adxl356-357.pdf (vendors.py fetch --client safari, HTTP 200, read 2026-10-02T10:27:37Z), Table 1: ranges ADXL356B +/-10 and +/-20 g, ADXL356C +/-10 and +/-40 g (so +/-16 g is met); resonant frequency 5.5 kHz typical; noise 75 ug/rtHz (+/-10 g) and 110 ug/rtHz (+/-40 g); 0 g offset vs temperature +/-0.2 typical, +/-0.75 maximum mg/degC; overall -3 dB bandwidth 2.4 kHz typical; output series resistance 32 kOhm typical (the same RFILT x CX structure as the ADXL316, so the lead buffer is needed); VSUPPLY 2.25 to 3.6 V; -40 to +125 degC; output swing only 0.03 V to V1P8ANA - 0.03 V (about 1.77 V), so the sensor board feeds the ADCS7476 less than its span. The data sheet states no temperature coefficient of the output resistor and no phase or delay figure, so 'delay drift between runs' is not shown, as for ADXL316. Fails rule 4: JLCPCB stockCount / canPresaleNumber read with vendors.py jlcpcb 2026-10-02T10:27:49Z to 10:27:51Z: C662368 7/7, C662369 0/0, C662370 0/0, C579461 12/12, C662371 24/23, C662372 0/0, all 'expand', all under the gate of 50 (prices at 1 piece USD 26 to 121).

exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: 'Higher operate points' does not hold on the maximum, which is the guaranteed figure. TMAG5115 data sheet SBASAJ1B (Dec 2022, rev Aug 2024), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tmag5115.pdf (vendors.py fetch, HTTP 200, read 2026-10-02T10:35:57Z), 6.6: TMAG5115A BOP 0.2 / 1 / 1.7 mT and BRP -1.7 / -1 / -0.2 mT (min / typ / max, over temperature, VCC 2.5 to 26 V). Rank 1 DRV5015A1 (SBAS915A, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/drv5015.pdf, read 2026-10-02T10:37:17Z) is BOP -0.2 / 0.7 / 2.0 mT, and ranks 2 and 3 share the 2.0 mT maximum. So the TMAG5115A1 has the lowest maximum operate point found (1.7 mT against 2.0 mT) and a higher typical (1.0 mT against 0.7 mT). It meets every other value: bipolar latch, open-drain (15 mA sink), holds its state; fBW 60 kHz, typical only (no minimum; fCHOP 1,000 kHz) against 1,092 Hz, where DRV5015's is 20 kHz minimum; VCC 2.5 to 26 V; -40 to +125 degC; tPD 5 typical, 6 maximum us; power-on 62.5 us. Its disadvantages are supply current 6 typical / 8 maximum mA (DRV5015: 2.3 / 2.8 mA) and the typical-only bandwidth. Stock: JLCPCB C22455387 (label Texas Instruments) stockCount 133, canPresaleNumber 133, library 'expand', USD 0.4422 at 1 piece (vendors.py jlcpcb, 2026-10-02T10:34:44Z); Digi-Key TMAG5115A1CQDBZR (vendors.py digikey, api.digikey.com/products/v4/search/TMAG5115A1CQDBZR/productdetails, read 2026-10-02T10:37:44Z): Active, lead time 20 weeks, stock 2,641 as cut tape (reel 0), so rule 5 passes as the same part at the second vendor. Against rank 3 AH1711-SA-7 (stock 100, 40-week lead time, 2.0 mT maximum) it is ahead on maximum operate point, JLCPCB stock and lead time; the re-rank decides its position against ranks 1 and 2.
